steps.rule: Confirm real latent cadet slot in exactly one cadet-class group.
Derive stable character_id from registry/group/slot identity.
Choose only from era/campaign-valid species population context.
Resolve origin/culture/citizenship/upbringing context independently from personality.
Use social/cultural naming context; remove reserved/canonical collisions.
Seed prior education, interests and hobbies without granting unsupported capability.
Bind current cadet class; resolve branch interests and specialization timing.
Call species-agnostic persistent personality pipeline with isolated personality seed.
Create isolated knowledge seed; actual knowledge remains constrained by education/experience/access.
Assign persistent base visual identity lineage compatible with species morphology.
Leave class groups, roommate, Academy relationships and schedule unresolved.
Bind slot→character_id, decrement latent count, preserve total count.
Append materialization provenance; no reroll after save/load/LOD/rules update.
